crossRefs.note: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?”
“Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits…

translations.web: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.
translations.bsb: And do not show favoritism to a poor man in his lawsuit.
translations.kjv: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
translations.asv: neither shalt thou favor a poor man in his cause.
